powerName: Require and examine catch or fishing equipment
description: Section 9(1)(b)(ii) states that the master may be required to produce catch, net, fishing gear or other equipment on board or belonging to the vessel, which may be examined.
conditions: The officer must meet the eligibility described in Section 9(1).
The purpose is ascertaining whether the requirements of the Act have been complied with.
The power is stated to be exercisable with or without a warrant.
limitations: The statutory text identifies the listed catch and equipment categories.
This record does not determine applicability in a particular situation.
source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
